claims.excerpt: Heat stress covered 84.4% of global reef area during the fourth bleaching event
claims.claim: The 84.4% heat-stress footprint occurred during the fourth global bleaching event.
claims.label: U
claims.evidence: From January 1, 2023 through September 30, 2025, roughly 84.4% of global coral reef area experienced bleaching-level heat stress. NOAA’s June 2026 update describes the fourth event as likely having ended in 2025.
claims.narrative: The scale of the heat-stress footprint—larger than the 68.2% recorded during the 2014–2017 event—makes the event record-setting by measured exposure
claims.explanation: The source associates the measurement window with the fourth event, but does not state when the event began; the window starts before the April 2024 confirmation. The headline compresses that chronology into “during the fourth bleaching event.”
claims.materiality: The headline could imply that the entire measurement window falls within the event, which the source does not establish.
